logic_errors.diagnosis: Unconditional raw-Lobby/outcome rejection incorrectly assumes native publication and the independently polled DOM change atomically. The bridge intentionally updates DOM every 100ms; the observer can see a newer raw Lobby alongside the previous displayed winner before that poll.
logic_errors.minimal_fix: Use a shared case-local page-clock transition rule allowing at most the explicit 100ms DOM-poll interval, requiring clearing and rejecting post-clear reappearance. Preserve independent 1000ms wire-Lobby-to-actual-clear bound and pre-wire winner proof. Do not change runtime code to satisfy this oracle.
